title: Analyst
desc: When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves . We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future. Summary: In this role, you will perform complex analyses and research related to supply chain and other focus areas as needed. You will monitor performance and make recommendations regarding potential project opportunities for value and savings across the health system. You will provide monthly status level reporting for goals achievement. You will interact with national and local team to maintain current contract specific understanding and performance status. Responsibilities: Conduct analyses of Information to produce repeatable results and identify solutions to complex problems. Identify and resolve member pricing discrepancies. Proactively determine customer needs; develop and recommend solutions from company portfolio. Support contract utilization and compliance to support territory sales and revenue goals. Conduct research as determined by the Enterprise Client Manager and supporting internal business units to develop programmatic offerings. Interpret trends, regulatory changes, and/or forecasts, and anticipates impact for Member goals. Gather and evaluate the quality of purchase data, revenue data, or any hospital-specific information needed to conduct comprehensive cost reduction analyses. Design and create data visualizations (charts, graphs, tables, and reports) to support findings and develop high level executive presentations. May present recommendations to management and provide guidance in selecting alternatives. Learn and gain expertise in all Vizient tools to train member staff and stakeholders. Qualifications: Relevant degree preferred. 2 or more years of related data analysis experience using complex data sets required. Comprehensive understanding of Microsoft Office Suite and other data visualization tools such as Tableau, including advanced capabilities in Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, or additional Business Intelligence platforms preferred. Previous experience in healthcare consulting, supply chain, pharmacy, strategic sourcing, business development, finance, or decision support preferred. Estimated Hiring Range: At Vizient, we consider skills, experience, and organizational needs in our compensation approach. Geographic factors may adjust the range estimate and hires typically fall below the top range. Compensation decisions are tailored to individual circumstances. The current salary range for this role is $51,900.00 to $87,900.00. This position is also incentive eligible. Vizient has a comprehensive benefits plan! Please view our benefits here: http://www.vizientinc.com/about-us/careers

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Data Curation - Autonomous Vehicles

The role involves applying state-of-the-art techniques to search, curate, and evaluate high-quality datasets and ground truth for autonomous vehicles, a critical aspect of our next-generation products. You will have the opportunity to work with top researchers and engineers in the field of deep learning and computer vision to deliver impact to our customers around the world. Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. The era of AI has begun. NVIDIA's GPUs run Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and act as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and AI come together in our architecture. NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI company”. Make your choice to join us today. We are training Deep Neural Networks and developing data search and curation capabilities for NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicles effort, with the goal to enable autonomous driving. We are seeking Deep Learning/Machine Learning engineers who are passionate about building the datasets and tools that support perception, prediction, planning and control for self-driving cars to achieve full autonomy. Are you interested in applying AI to discover and understand challenging driving scenarios at scale? If so, join us! What you'll be doing: Stay up to date with the latest research and innovations in deep learning, implement and experiment with new ideas. Foster collaborative partnerships with our researchers and engineers, transforming innovative research into robust, industrial-strength machine learning models. Taking approaches from initial evaluation and experimentation all the way to shipping. Defining, collecting, and curating training and evaluation datasets, with a focus on scenario coverage and label quality. Developing vision-language models and embeddings for scenario search, classification, and automated data curation. Building training pipelines and scalable inference systems (PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorRT, Python, C++). What we need to see: PhD with 1+ year, or MS (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years, of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Proven experience building robust software. Passionate about Artificial Intelligence for robotics and autonomous navigation Strive to learn new things and like solving hard problems Math knowledge Experience in Deep Learning / Machine Learning. You have a background in Computer Vision and/or multimodal learning. Programming and debugging skills in C++ and/or Python. Good communication and analytical skills. Ability to work with multiple teams in a dynamic environment. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Background in applying latest AI methods to solve Computer Vision and Autonomous Vehicles problems Experience with Unsupervised or Self-supervised Learning and contrastive representation learning. Experience with vision-language models, agentic search, or automated dataset quality evaluation. We believe that realizing self-driving cars will be a defining contribution of our generation. We have the funding and scale, but we need your help. NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you. #AutonomousVehicles You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . title: Research Scientist, AI and Systems Security - PhD New College Grad 2026
desc: We are looking for a Research Scientist to advance security, safety, and privacy across three complementary research areas: (1) security of AI models and systems; (2) AI-enabled design and verification of secure computer systems; and (3) AI for cybersecurity. The first area includes making AI models, agents, data pipelines, runtimes, and accelerated computing platforms secure, safe, private, and resilient to attack, misuse, data leakage, and other failures. AI-enabled design and verification includes using AI, together with systems and formal techniques, to design, analyze, implement, and verify secure hardware and software systems. AI for cybersecurity includes applying AI to vulnerability discovery, secure systems development, threat detection, incident analysis, and automated defense. Across these three areas, we aim to build secure, safe, and private systems from first principles by co-designing hardware, software, AI models, algorithms, and operational controls. Our goal is to provide strong, measurable, and where possible verifiable protection while preserving performance, energy efficiency, and usability. We welcome researchers with depth in one area and interest in contributing across the broader agenda. NVIDIA is a leader in accelerated computing and AI systems. This role offers the opportunity to shape the security and safety foundations of emerging AI platforms, develop new approaches for AI-enabled secure system design and verification, and advance AI-powered cybersecurity in collaboration with research, product, and engineering teams. What you'll be doing: Advance the security, safety, and privacy of AI models and systems across the full lifecycle, including data collection, training, model and agent behavior, inference, deployment, and platform operations. Develop AI-enabled methods to design, analyze, implement, and verify computer systems, including hardware architectures, system software, runtimes, compilers, and applications; rigorously evaluate security, safety, privacy, performance, and efficiency tradeoffs. Advance AI for cybersecurity by developing techniques for vulnerability discovery, secure code generation and review, threat detection, incident analysis, security validation, and automated defense. Collaborate across hardware, software, research, and product teams; publish original research; and help translate research advances into practical systems and developer capabilities. What we need to see: A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a strong research background in security, AI/ML, computer architecture, operating systems, formal methods, programming languages and compilers, software systems, or other related areas. A record of research excellence demonstrated through publications, open-source systems, patents, technology transfer, or substantial research collaborations. Deep expertise in at least one of the three research areas—security of AI models and systems, AI-enabled design and verification of secure computer systems, or AI for cybersecurity—with the ability to connect that depth to challenges across the hardware/software stack. Strong experimental research and prototyping skills, including the ability to build systems, define threat models, design meaningful evaluations, and analyze security and performance tradeoffs. Strong programming skills in C, C++, Python, and/or relevant systems and machine-learning frameworks, along with clear written and verbal communication skills. We are looking for creative, collaborative, and self-directed researchers who want to secure AI models and systems, use AI to help design and verify secure computer systems, and expand what AI can do for cybersecurity. Candidates do not need to be experts in all three areas, but should be excited to work across disciplines and help turn new ideas into high-impact research and technology. NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. This is our life’s work — to amplify human imagination and intelligence. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most hardworking, resourceful and dedicated people in the world working for us. Are you a security researcher who loves the challenge of exploring and crafting techniques that will impact our future products? If so, we want to hear from you! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 168,000 USD – 264,500 USD.
